summary: The canteen has an overall rating of 2.48 out of 5, based on 132 aspect mentions. Waiting time is a significant concern, with 83% of mentions being negative. Quantity and price are also major issues, with 80% and 70% of mentions, respectively, being negative. Food quality and staff behavior are less negative, but still often criticized, with 51% and 50% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The classrooms have an overall rating of 2.84 out of 5, based on 112 mentions. Noise is the biggest concern, with 75% of mentions being negative. Lighting and projector/av equipment are also major issues, with 64% and 62% of mentions being negative, respectively. Seating and cleanliness were less negative than these areas, but still often criticized, with 42% and 44% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The hostel mess has an overall rating of 2.47 out of 5, based on 116 aspect mentions. The biggest concerns raised by students include the quantity of food, with 86% of mentions being negative, and the waiting time, with 85% of mentions being negative. Students also expressed dissatisfaction with the variety of food, with 80% of mentions being negative. In contrast, staff behavior received fewer complaints, with 38% of mentions being negative, and price was less negative than other areas, but still often critizised, with 44% of mentions being negative.

The hostel rooms received an overall rating of 2.39 out of 5. The biggest concerns raised by students were maintenance, noise, and water supply, with 88% of mentions being negative for the first two and 73% for the third. Cleanliness and electricity were also frequently criticized, with 48% and 50% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The labs received an overall rating of 2.82 out of 5 from student feedback. The biggest concerns were equipment condition, with 69% of mentions being negative, and lab timings, with 59% of mentions being negative. Software availability was also a concern, with 54% of mentions being negative. In contrast, space and cleanliness received fewer complaints, with 14% and 33% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The library received an overall rating of 2.54 out of 5 from student feedback. The biggest concerns were opening hours, with 75% of mentions being negative, air conditioning/temperature, with 73%, and silence, with 69%. In contrast, digital resources received relatively few complaints, with only 18% of mentions being negative. Staff behavior was also criticized, with 46% of mentions being negative, although less so than the other areas of concern.

The transport facility received an overall rating of 2.5 out of 5 from student feedback. The biggest concerns were crowding, with 88% of mentions being negative, and bus condition, with 69% of mentions being negative. Additionally, safety was a concern, with 62% of mentions being negative. Driver behavior and fare were also criticized, with 41% and 57% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The wifi facility has an overall rating of 2.31 out of 5 from 119 aspect mentions. The biggest concerns raised by students include login issues, with 76% of mentions being negative, and reliability, with 73% of mentions also being negative. Additionally, bandwidth limits were criticized by 69% of mentions. Coverage and connectivity were also issues, with 50% and 61% of mentions being negative, respectively.
